title: World Settlement Footprint Evolution: the year each 30 m cell first stood built, 1985-2015
provider: German Aerospace Center (DLR), Earth Observation Center, with the World Bank; the WSF Evolution download directory
format: GeoTIFF, one band of int32, WGS 84, tiles of 2 x 2 degrees named by their south-west corner, 256 x 256 internal tiles, LZW: the year in 1985-2015 in which a cell was first detected as settlement from Landsat, 0 where never.
coverage: The tiles of the workbench's cities: Melbourne (144_-38), New York (-76_40 and -74_40, which meet at 74 W), Freetown (-14_8).
citation: Marconcini, M., Metz-Marconcini, A., Esch, T. and Gorelick, N. (2021), Understanding Current Trends in Global Urbanisation: The World Settlement Footprint Suite, GI_Forum 9(1), 33-38. The 10 m World Settlement Footprint Tracker (ESA, DLR, World Bank; 2016-2026) has no open download of its grids, and is not used.
